evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On a synthetic Landsat-8 benchmark with six degradation types, EORestore-Agent improves PSNR by 2.3 to 3.2 dB over the strongest retrained all-in-one baseline on composites of two to six degradations, whereas zero-shot natural-image agents fall below the degraded input in PSNR in 17 of 18 settings.

evidence.excerpt: Sentinel-2 examples illustrate transfer to real atmospheric degradation without retraining.
